<P>Part III - Narrative</P>

<P>State below in reasonable detail the reasons why the Form 10-K and Form 10-KSB, 20-F, 11-K, 10-Q and Form 10-QSB, N-SAR or the transition report or portion thereof could not be filed within the prescribed time period.</P>

<P>Due to a delay in making adjustments necessary to record the recent private placement financing the Company was unable to secure audit committee approval to file the Form 10-Q on August 14, 2001, as required. The Company's Form 10-Q will be filed no later than Friday, August 17, 2001. </P>
